scientific_integrity: All displayed universal identities are analytic consequences of spherical and compact-group integral identities; accompanying finite numerical checks are only diagnostics. Originality applies to the complete arbitrary-side-length tensor and finite-dimensional covariance structure after crediting known cases. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional second moments only: no distributional law, no higher moments, and no nonorthogonal parallelotopes. The dimension-three cube value and leading large-dimensional cube-variance coefficient are known earlier results. Unindexed historical integration formulas could imply parts of the tensor; their absence has not been proved.
title: Exact planar shadow-area moments for all orthotopes
